summary: Comprehensive audit of the entire portfolio system covering: (1) loop-engineering workflow integrity, (2) security posture (CSP, rate limiting, action pinning, secrets), (3) smart caching layers (L1/L2/SWR/ISR/service worker), (4) automated test coverage gaps, (5) workflow infrastructure validation, and (6) documentation accuracy. Every finding gets a test or validation. Every fix gets its own commit.
narrative: The portfolio has 24 GitHub Actions workflows, 3 loop-engineering loops, 70 test files, a multi-layer cache system, and extensive security configurations. But no single audit has validated that all these systems work together correctly. This PRD creates a systematic audit that: tests every loop-engineering file and workflow, validates security configurations are effective (not just present), confirms caching layers actually cache, identifies test coverage gaps, and checks documentation accuracy. Each audit finding becomes a test. Each fix becomes a commit. The goal is a provably-correct system with automated regression prevention.
principles: Audit everything, assume nothing — validate that configs are correct, not just present
Every finding gets a test — automated regression prevention, not just a report
Every fix gets a commit — one slice per change for maximum git history
Security first — CSP weaknesses, rate limiter gaps, and action pinning inconsistencies are high priority
Cache correctness — verify that caching layers actually cache and invalidation works
Documentation accuracy — AGENTS.md must match reality (versions, counts, references)
No regressions — all existing 708+ tests must continue passing

designDecisions.choice: Write audit tests that validate system correctness, not just file existence. Each test checks behavior, not just presence.
designDecisions.rationale: File existence tests are weak — they pass even if the file content is wrong. Behavior tests catch real issues.

designDecisions.choice: Create a separate fix PRD after audit completes. Each fix is one commit. No batch fixes.
designDecisions.rationale: Separating audit from fix keeps the audit clean and the fixes auditable. One commit per fix is maximally revertable.

designDecisions.choice: Pin all GitHub Actions to SHA hashes, matching the convention used by the other 21 workflows.
designDecisions.rationale: Supply-chain security. Tag references can be moved; SHA pins cannot. zizmor flags this.

designDecisions.choice: Correct AGENTS.md version numbers and test counts to match actual values.
designDecisions.rationale: Stale documentation erodes trust. Agents relying on AGENTS.md will make wrong assumptions.

designDecisions.choice: Document the fallback behavior and add a test validating in-memory mode works. Do not implement Upstash (separate task).
designDecisions.rationale: The rate limiter works — it just degrades gracefully without Upstash. Documenting this is sufficient for the audit.

designDecisions.choice: Document the unsafe-inline weakness and nonce-based improvement path. Do not implement (requires Next.js changes).
designDecisions.rationale: Full CSP overhaul is a separate project. The audit identifies it; the fix PRD can plan it.

epics.title: Audit workflow infrastructure
epics.summary: Validate all 24 GitHub Actions workflows: correct triggers, valid YAML, SHA-pinned actions, referenced scripts exist, no broken cross-references.

stories.title: Create workflow validation test suite
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/workflow-audit.test.ts. Test that each workflow YAML file: (a) exists, (b) is valid YAML, (c) has correct trigger types, (d) references only existing npm scripts, (e) uses SHA-pinned actions (no tag references like @v4).

stories.title: Create action pinning audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/action-pinning.test.ts. Parse all workflow YAML files, extract all 'uses:' references, validate each is either a local path (./) or a SHA-pinned reference (contains full SHA hash). Flag any tag-based references (@v4, @v7, etc).

stories.title: Create workflow cross-reference audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/workflow-crossref.test.ts. Validate that: problem-detection-advisor.yml monitors workflows that exist, remediation-approval-gate.yml monitors workflows that exist, auto-approve.yml checks job names that match actual job names in referenced workflows.

epics.title: Loop-engineering integrity audit
epics.summary: Validate all loop-engineering files and workflows are correct, consistent, and functional.

stories.title: Enhance loop-engineering tests with behavior checks
stories.details: Update src/__tests__/loop-engineering.test.ts to add behavior tests: (a) STATE.md content is not stale (contains actual loop names, not placeholder text), (b) LOOP.md cadence values are valid cron expressions, (c) loop-budget.md token caps are positive integers, (d) loop-run-log.md format matches the documented schema.

stories.title: Create loop workflow behavior audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/loop-workflow-audit.test.ts. For each loop workflow: validate the kill switch step exists and checks the correct label, validate STATE.md generation step produces valid markdown, validate run log append step uses correct format.

stories.title: Create loop consistency audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/loop-consistency.test.ts. Cross-validate: (a) every loop in LOOP.md has a matching workflow file, (b) every loop workflow references the correct loop name in run log entries, (c) loop-budget.md lists every loop in LOOP.md, (d) STATE.md references match actual workflow file names.

epics.title: Security audit
epics.summary: Audit security configurations: CSP headers, rate limiting, action pinning, secret handling, middleware security.

stories.title: Create CSP audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/csp-audit.test.ts. Validate: (a) CSP header is present in next.config.js, (b) report-uri endpoint is configured, (c) script-src includes 'self', (d) frame-ancestors is restricted, (e) document the unsafe-inline weakness with a TODO comment for nonce-based approach.

stories.title: Create rate limiter audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/rate-limiter-audit.test.ts. Validate: (a) rate limiter is imported in middleware, (b) Upstash fallback to in-memory is documented, (c) rate limit values are reasonable (not 0 or Infinity), (d) test that in-memory mode works correctly.

stories.title: Create security headers audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/security-headers-audit.test.ts. Validate: (a) HSTS header is present with max-age >= 1 year, (b) X-Content-Type-Options is nosniff, (c) X-Powered-By is suppressed, (d) Referrer-Policy is set, (e) Permissions-Policy restricts camera/microphone/geolocation.

stories.title: Create secret handling audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/secret-handling-audit.test.ts. Validate: (a) .env.local is in .gitignore, (b) .env.example exists and documents required vars, (c) no hardcoded secrets in source files (grep for patterns), (d) API key comparison uses timing-safe comparison.

epics.title: Caching audit
epics.summary: Audit all caching layers: L1 in-memory, L2 Upstash Redis, SWR configuration, ISR, service worker, Next.js cache headers.

stories.title: Create L1 cache audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/cache-l1-audit.test.ts. Validate: (a) cache.ts exports set/get/delete/has functions, (b) TTL default is reasonable (60-600s), (c) stale-while-revalidate is implemented, (d) cache respects max size limit, (e) cache cleanup works.

stories.title: Create SWR config audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/swr-config-audit.test.ts. Validate: (a) SWR config exports correct dedupingInterval, (b) revalidateOnFocus is configured, (c) errorRetryCount is set, (d) keepPreviousData is configured.

stories.title: Create service worker audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/service-worker-audit.test.ts. Validate: (a) public/sw.js exists, (b) cache version is documented, (c) static assets are pre-cached, (d) navigation requests use network-first strategy, (e) offline fallback exists.

stories.title: Create Next.js cache headers audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/nextjs-cache-audit.test.ts. Validate: (a) next.config.js has cache headers for _next/static, (b) fonts have immutable cache, (c) favicon has appropriate cache, (d) stale-while-revalidate is used where appropriate.

epics.title: Test coverage audit
epics.summary: Identify test coverage gaps and add tests for untested critical paths.

stories.title: Create test inventory audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/test-inventory.test.ts. Validate: (a) test count matches expected minimum (70+ files), (b) critical paths have tests (middleware, API routes, caching, security), (c) no test files are empty, (d) vitest config thresholds are reasonable.

stories.title: Create middleware coverage audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/middleware-coverage.test.ts. Validate: (a) bot-blocker has tests, (b) rate-limiter has tests, (c) content-type validation has tests, (d) middleware integration has tests.

epics.title: Documentation accuracy audit

stories.title: Create documentation accuracy audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/docs-accuracy.test.ts. Validate: (a) AGENTS.md react-doctor version matches package.json, (b) AGENTS.md test count matches actual test file count, (c) AGENTS.md workflow references match actual workflow files, (d) STATE.md sections exist and are populated.

stories.title: Create PRD status audit test
stories.details: Create src/__tests__/audit/prd-status.test.ts. Validate: (a) all PRD files in docs/prd/ have valid JSON, (b) PRD story counts match actual 'done' counts, (c) no PRD references non-existent files.

epics.title: Create fix PRD
epics.summary: After audit completes, create docs/prd/prd.system-audit-fixes.json documenting all findings and planned fixes.

stories.title: Create fix PRD from audit findings
stories.details: Create docs/prd/prd.system-audit-fixes.json. For each audit finding: document the issue, the fix approach, the affected files, and the verification test. Group by priority (high/medium/low).

epics.title: Verification
epics.summary: Run the full quality gate: tsc, eslint, vitest (including new audit tests), react-doctor.

stories.title: Run tsc, eslint, vitest
stories.details: Run: npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, npm run test -- --run. All must pass with the new audit tests included.

stories.title: Run react-doctor
stories.details: Run npm run doctor. No new findings from the added audit test files.
